idea-plugin.name: SuperJump
idea-plugin.description:
SuperJump jumps to a website based on the text under the cursor.

  • Super Jump (Ctrl+Shift+9): matches the selection, word or line against configurable regex "jumpers" and opens the resulting URL.
  • Super Jump to Git source repository (Ctrl+Shift+0): opens the current file and line on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps.

Configure jumpers under Settings | Tools | SuperJump. URL templates can use $1, $2, ... for regex capture groups.

action.description: Jump to website based on selected text
